component: Xing4.0 fast tokenizer build, exact reference decode/streaming, and reasoning/tool-call output parser
source_repository: Hugging Face Xing4.0-29B-A4B repository files; vLLM PR 57135 and SGLang PR 39793 (unmerged), fetched 2026-09-18
source_revision: files as fetched 2026-09-18 (identified by sha256 below; the PRs were not merged)
license_source: Xing4.0 model card (license: apache-2.0); vLLM and SGLang SPDX headers (Apache-2.0)

tokenization_xing4_0.py.use: behavioural reference only (slow Xing4_0Tokenizer, run with trust_remote_code to generate the parity corpus and fixture); no code copied

chat_template.jinja.use: rendered unchanged through transformers apply_chat_template; not copied

vllm_xing4_0_tool_parser.py (vLLM PR 571.use: tool-call semantics adapted: _deserialize (json.loads then ast.literal_eval then raw), _json_arguments (arguments/parameters/object), NAME{json} payload split with longest declared name first, string-typed parameters kept raw, key/value strip

vllm_xing4_0_reasoning_parser.py (vLLM P.use: channel semantics: output starts in reasoning when thinking is on, </think> ends it, thinking off is all content, unterminated reasoning stays reasoning

sgl_patches.txt (SGLang PR 39793 reasoni.use: force_nonempty_content=True reviewed and deliberately not reproduced (see src/mlx2/adapters/xing_output.py docstring)

modifications: Tokenizer: original construction with the tokenizers library (no transformers SPM converter): BPE merges derived from SentencePiece piece scores, Prepend+Replace normalizer applied per chunk between registered specials (per-chunk dummy-prefix quirk), isolating Split pre-tokenizer for user-defined symbols with BPE ignore_merges, byte_fallback; build asserts every standalone NORMAL piece is merge-reachable

Decode: exact reimplementation of the reference decode (per-run sp.decode between registered specials, one leading U+2581 consumed per run, control pieces empty, <_unk> as ' ⁇ ', per-byte U+FFFD) installed on the loaded fast tokenizer, plus a linear streaming detokenizer that equals the full decode at every step
Kept reference quirks: <_observation>/<_sep>/<_controlN>/<reserveN> behave exactly as the slow tokenizer (unregistered controls encode as literal text), add_bos_token false

Parser: rewritten for the mlx2 delta-event contract; tool calls only in content and only with declared tools; union schemas admitting string keep raw text and 'null' decodes to None when null is admitted; non-finite or non-JSON literal values stay text; undeclared tools, missing required/undeclared parameters, duplicate/malformed parameters and incomplete blocks raise instead of leaking markup; whitespace adjacent to tool calls dropped; one template newline before </think> dropped; stops apply to content only
validation: scripts/xing4_0_tokenizer.py parity vs the live slow reference (transformers 5.12.1, tokenizers 0.22.2, sentencepiece 0.2.1): 254,983 strings (250,000 seeded unicode fuzz, 4,009 chat renders, 974 structured) and 634,966 decode checks (both skip modes, 62,500 random id sequences, streaming) all identical; separately 26,245 strings incl. 88 real-text files identical
tests/test_xing_tokenizer.py, tests/test_xing_output.py (CPU; model-backed cases skip without tokenizer.model)
